description: Six turns in one fictional offline conversation: paraphrase, cross-directory multi-input discovery, unrelated edit and heading rename, counterevidence, then context refresh and actual evidence reads.
goal: 复核虚构报表下载流程的前提及证据；组合始终需要独立验证。

scoring.required: Hand-labelled record and observation identities needed for each current question. Cursor refs count only when the replay retained their previously delivered bodies.
scoring.allowed: Hand-labelled permitted record/observation set for this question, including the active goal, conflicting provider and negative observation. Items outside the set count as label-defined extra returns, not intrinsically irrelevant truth.
scoring.tokens: No model call or tokenizer. host_tokens is null; Unicode JSON characters are measured.
scoring.read_policy: Only explicitly listed read actions are executed. They are scripted verification reads, not inferred Claude behavior or an estimate of real follow-up calls.
